newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Lace to announce share issue cancellation.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Lace to announce share issue cancellation.

text.p: Nippon Lace Co Ltd said on Friday that it would hold a news conference at 5.50 p.m. (0850 GMT) to announce cancellation of its rescheduled new share issue.
No further details were immediately available.
Nippon Lace said in March that it would proceed in early April with a plan for a third-party allocation of new shares that had previously been cancelled.
Under the rescheduled plan, the company said it would issue six million new shares at 280 yen per share to two investors, with a payment date of April 7.

Under the original share plan, announced in February, the company hoped to issue six million new shares at 590 yen per share. It cancelled the plan on March 11, however, due to a fall in share prices.
The lace manufacturers' shares on Friday closed up eight yen at 249 yen.
